title: Phoenix Save Schema Version
description: Shape of project/Config/save_schema.json. That 'current' equals the version tools/migration/migrate_save.py writes, and that every step from minimumReadable is a registered migration, are code relations; tools/validation/validate_versions.py enforces them.

current.description: The schema version this build writes.

minimumReadable.description: The oldest schema version this build can migrate forward.
